JB Mobility is hiring a Software Engineer to develop and maintain enterprise applications using Java and Spring Boot. The role focuses on scalable backend systems, collaboration across teams, and communication with Korean-speaking clients and stakeholders.
Automotive
Consulting
Software
Growth Opportunities
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and high-performance applications using Java and the Spring Framework
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, define technical solutions, and deliver high-quality software products
Develop clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that adheres to industry best practices, coding standards, and design principles
Conduct code reviews, mentor team members, and provide constructive feedback to improve code quality and maintainability
Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues while continuously optimizing system performance, scalability, and reliability
Create and maintain technical documentation, including system architecture, API specifications, design documents, and operational procedures to support long-term maintainability
Participate in software design discussions, technical planning, and architecture decisions to ensure scalable and sustainable solutions
Communicate effectively with Korean-speaking clients, stakeholders, and engineering teams to align technical solutions with business requirements and project objectives

Required
1 to 3+ years of professional experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise software applications
Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, and the Spring ecosystem
Solid understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP), software design principles, and common design patterns
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and distributed microservices-based applications
Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture and messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka or other message brokers
Proficiency with relational database systems (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL) and SQL optimization
Experience with version control systems (Git) and modern software development workflows
Familiarity with software testing methodologies, debugging, and performance tuning
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams
Professional proficiency in Korean, with the ability to communicate effectively with Korean-speaking clients and stakeholders
